SELECT COUNT(*) AS flight_count
FROM flights f
JOIN airports sa ON f.SourceAirport = sa.AirportCode AND sa.City = 'Aberdeen'
JOIN airports da ON f.DestAirport = da.AirportCode AND da.City = 'Ashley';
